articles.title: Live-Action Moana Makes a Splash — But It’s a Belly Flop
articles.summary: Disney’s live-action Moana debuted to a dismal 33% on Rotten Tomatoes, with critics blasting its “AI slop” visuals and “exquisite agony.” It now ranks among the worst remakes, just above 102 Dalmatians. Will Disney finally get the message?

articles.title: America’s 250th Birthday Time Capsule: Diamonds, AI, and a Giant Snake
articles.summary: A time capsule buried in Philadelphia for America’s 250th birthday holds a diamond, a whale bone, an AI prediction, and more. Sealed to survive 250 years, it’s marked by a granite snake inspired by Franklin’s “Join, or Die” cartoon.

articles.title: Wildcard Wonder: Arthur Fery Storms into Wimbledon Semis
articles.summary: Unranked just 18 months ago, British wildcard Arthur Fery stunned world No. 10 Flavio Cobolli in straight sets to become the first men’s wildcard in 25 years to reach the Wimbledon semi-finals. Next up: French Open champ Zverev.
